records.issue_text: Admin group update sets visible to false when the parameter is omitted, so partial PATCH requests can unexpectedly hide the group
records.rationale: The diff shows in groups_controller.rb line 'group.visible = params[:visible] == "true"' in the update method. This means if the 'visible' parameter is not provided (nil), the comparison 'nil == "true"' returns false, so group.visible will be set to false. This is a real bug where partial updates that don't include the visible parameter will unexpectedly set visible to false.

records.issue_text: After deleting the only member on the last page, findMembers clamps the offset using the stale pre-deletion user_count and reloads an empty out-of-range page
records.rationale: Looking at the findMembers function in group.js, the offset is clamped using: `var offset = Math.min(this.get('user_count'), Math.max(this.get('offset'), 0))`. When removeMember is called, it deletes the user via AJAX and then calls `self.findMembers()` to reload.
